Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA
DOC-0030 2026-10-18
MEMORANDUM
Date: 2026-10-18
To: DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA queue coordinators
From: PERSON-0006, TEAM-0006
Subject: Weekly BETA Queue Report Uses Decision Fields
Decision: From 2026-10-19, DEMO-PROGRAM-BETA's weekly queue report
will use a decision-focused layout. Each entry provides a locating reference,
subsystem, owning team, question requiring a decision, dependency role, next
action, and next discussion date.
Add a schedule-change column for a moved appointment or a changed
receiving role. Preserve the prior appointment alongside its replacement so
that the reader can understand why a discussion moved. The report layout
must not include workload figures, totals, or a copied snapshot of record
categories.
The structures discussion at the review staffing meeting informed this layout.
Its working folder is located through DEMO-AIR-0002 and ISSUE-0150;
TASK-0895 may identify a related paper. Those references illustrate the
arrangement of fields rather than an entry selected for the weekly report.
The records editor should return entries that contain only a short topic label.
Ask the submitting coordinator to state the decision needed and the role
responsible for obtaining it. If a dependency role is unknown, the owning
team must provide a contact plan and date.
Implementation: PERSON-0006 will circulate the blank layout on 2026-10-19.
The program chair will review its clarity on 2026-10-26, using questions about
field meaning rather than tallying the queue. Retain any format correction
with the dated layout so station editors use the same headings.
D. Worker 0006
Demo Worker 0006, Demo Team 06
